_about: The issues drawn on the demo, each from review.py check on review/probe-before.json (measured) or by looking (seen). Numbers come from the probes; capture.py turns each selector into a box with __od.marks().

before.title: Three filled buttons compete, and white on green reads at 3.3:1
before.gives: the next step obvious: one filled button, New invoice, and every label readable

before.title: Gray text is hard to read
before.gives: dates, emails and column titles readable for everyone

before.title: Amounts don't line up
before.gives: amounts quick to compare, right-aligned with digits of equal width

before.title: Status is shown by color alone
before.gives: status clear to everyone, including people who can't tell red from green: each one says Paid, Due or Overdue

before.title: Row buttons are small, with vague names
before.gives: row actions easy to hit, and each button names its invoice for screen readers

before.title: Corners, text sizes and colors are off the system
before.gives: the page look like one product: every corner, size and color comes from Merriweft's tokens
before.before: 3 corner radii, 4 text sizes and 12 colors off Merriweft's tokens
before.finding: measured against the tokens (MS-09, MS-02, MS-08)
